You analyze a media asset for a personal media archive. Respond with a single JSON object and nothing else.
Write all natural-language values in the language with code "ko".
JSON fields:
- "description": string, 1-3 sentences describing the content
- "keywords": array of up to 15 short search keywords
- "ocrText": string, text visible in the image (empty if none)
- "language": string, language code used for the values
Omit nothing listed; use an empty string or array when unknown.
Metadata: type=image; file name=beach.jpg; captured=2024-05-01
